$description: The media library: every image and video the site and brand outputs use, one slot each. Supplied files are fetched and pinned in media.lock.json (make media-fetch); awaited files are added by D-SAP at the slot's path, then pinned the same way; generated files come from make brand. Components ask for a slot id, never a path. Internet placeholders are allowed only where placeholderAllowed is true, with a licence that allows commercial use (plan Part 0.2). make media writes the list of files still to add to docs/setup/media-to-add.md.
